opportunity.title: When details scatter, operational clarity weakens.
opportunity.body: Maintenance work does not break down only because teams are stretched. It breaks down when details scatter: a request in a message, a follow-up on a call, an asset without a clear record, and a report that does not explain what should happen next.
opportunity.closing: Mutqan brings these details together in one connected system.

aboutPage.heroTitle: A system born from operational needs, not a ready-made template
aboutPage.heroBody: We built Mutqan to speak the language of facility managers, supervisors, and technicians: a clear request, a known asset, a defined owner, and a report the team can return to.
aboutPage.storyTitle: From scattered requests to measurable operations
aboutPage.storyBodyOne: The problem often starts small: a request in a chat, a missing paper, an asset without history, or a maintenance task no one can confirm was actually closed. Over time, small details become downtime, cost, and pressure on the team.
aboutPage.storyBodyTwo: Mutqan addresses this at the root: it unifies information, clarifies responsibility, and turns daily work into a clear record for both the team and management.
aboutPage.visionTitle: Make digital maintenance a simple daily practice
aboutPage.visionBody: The system should not add burden to the team. It should reduce follow-up, improve decision clarity, and help the facility stay prepared instead of always reacting.

principles.title: From the field
principles.body: Mutqan treats maintenance as daily operational work with failures, teams, locations, assets, and fast decisions, not just a task list.

principles.title: Clarity first
principles.body: Every screen should help the user understand what happened, what is overdue, who owns it, and what comes next.

principles.title: Operational confidence
principles.body: Records, permissions, statuses, and reports are designed to give management visibility instead of relying on manual follow-up.
